com.agents-nexus.agent-memory.flush: Flushes buffered tmux + agent events to the agent-memory DB
com.agents-nexus.automode-watchdog: Watches for Claude Code's fail-closed auto-mode classifier denials and cycles a stuck pane to Manual mode, reverting once idle
com.agents-nexus.doc-vault: Indexes agent-authored HTML docs and serves them on localhost:8310; polls the crawl roots every 120s. Optionally gates a Cloudflare-tunnel-facing port behind Access
com.agents-nexus.docker: Starts the agents-nexus Docker stack at login (proxy, langfuse, mnemon)
com.agents-nexus.factory-intake: Every 15 min on weekdays: claims one factory-labelled ticket from the tracker queue, dispatches a Conductor mission, then hands the resulting MR to the swarm review loop
com.agents-nexus.deflection-report: Weekly: runs the chatbot deflection report headlessly and delivers it through the Slack plugin (DM until promoted to the channel)
com.agents-nexus.langfuse-cost-snapshot: Daily: snapshots Langfuse cost/usage into Postgres so spend history survives the 10-day trace TTL
com.agents-nexus.flywheel-report: Daily: writes the flywheel report (seat spend, Conductor retries, unread context, unused skills) to ~/.local/share/agents-nexus/flywheel/ and deposits a new version of the 'Flywheel report — daily' doc-vault entry
com.agents-nexus.muninn.sync: Syncs reMarkable rM1 handwritten pages into the Obsidian vault
com.agents-nexus.notify-pipeline-check: Hourly: verifies the notify-classify permission gate is still absorbing prompts (handled-rate, classifier reachability, log rotation, presence-plugin canary) and pings Slack only on an anomaly
com.agents-nexus.obs-decay: Weekly review: surfaces stale Obsidian notes for the user to action
com.agents-nexus.obs-digest: Digests the previous business day's Obsidian notes and posts to Slack
com.agents-nexus.obs-tag: Auto-tags newly-modified Obsidian notes via Claude
com.agents-nexus.obs-tidy: Tidies the Obsidian vault (broken links, orphans) and posts a Slack summary
com.agents-nexus.permission-suggest: Weekly: proposes safe Claude Code permission-allowlist additions from recent transcripts and pings Slack (propose-only)
com.agents-nexus.slack-bridge: Slack Socket Mode bridge — routes #nexus messages and thread replies to the right agent, and posts agent input-requests back to Slack
com.agents-nexus.example-service-mr-labe: Auto-applies hygiene labels, assignees, and reviewers to open example-service MRs (classification belongs to mr-triage)
com.agents-nexus.example-service-mr-tria: Daily: classifies open example-service MRs on category::/intent::/priority:: from the linked tracker issue
com.agents-nexus.minions-dashboard: Serves the read-only minions dashboard on localhost:8312: launchd timers, cron ledgers and stamps, Conductor missions, review loops, fleet panes
